rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when something is done subject to conditions.

example.english: We can conditionally agree to your request.
example.traditional: 我哋可以有條件噉答應你個要求。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jau5 tiu4 gin2 gam2 daap3 jing3 nei5 go3 jiu1 kau4

rows.note: Use this when you want to state the specific condition under which something applies.

example.english: We will conditionally sign the lease if the other party agrees to lower the rent.
example.traditional: 喺對方肯減租呢個條件下，我哋先會簽約。
example.jyutping: hai2 deoi3 fong1 hang2 gaam2 zou1 ne1 go3 tiu4 gin6 haa6 ngo5 dei6 sin1 wui5 cim1 joek3
